Creator: Amaal Khandwalla
Description:
*User Story:* As a delinquent account customer, I want to sign into my portal securely using 2-Factor Authentication (Date of Birth + SMS/Email OTP), so that I can access my account balance safely without exposing personal financial data.



*Business Value:* Ensures FCA data privacy compliance and prevents unauthorized portal access while replacing manual security checks.



*Acceptance Criteria:*

*Given* a customer enters their account reference and Date of Birth on the portal landing page,

*When* they request verification, 

*Then* the system sends a 6-digit One-Time Password (OTP) via SMS/email using the registered contact details within 10 seconds.

*Given* a customer enters a valid OTP,

*When* verified against the system token,

*Then* the session is authenticated and redirects to the Account Summary screen.

*Given* a customer enters an incorrect OTP 3 consecutive times,

*When* the 3rd attempt fails, 

*Then* the portal locks self-service access, displays a security lockout screen, and routes a security follow-up task to the Representative queue.



*Dependencies:* Legacy Collections Database API (for contact detail retrieval), Outbound Messaging Gateway (SMS/Email).



*Priority:* High

Summary: Story VIS-01: Real-Time Balance & Delinquency Status Display
Creator: Amaal Khandwalla
Description:
**User Story:** As an authenticated customer, I want to view my current outstanding balance, overdue amount, and delinquency status, so that I can understand my exact financial obligation without calling a representative.



**Business Value:** Directly eliminates routine `view_status` and `spreadsheet_reconcile` representative tasks (BM-16 = 2,468 view status actions).



**Acceptance Criteria:**

**Given** an authenticated customer session begins,

**When** the Account Summary page loads,

**Then** the portal displays total balance, overdue amount, days past due (DPD), and current account status retrieved from the Legacy Database.

**Given** a database connection delay exceeds 3 seconds,

**When** loading balance details,

**Then** the portal displays a friendly loading state and fallback retry option without crashing.



**Dependencies:** Legacy Collections Database Read API (Epic 1).



**Priority:** High

Summary: Story PAY-01: Pre-Approved Payment Plan Selection
Creator: Amaal Khandwalla
Description:
*User Story:* As an early-stage delinquent customer (1–29 DPD), I want to select a pre-approved 3–6 month installment plan, so that I can clear my debt at an affordable pace.



*Business Value:* Drives self-service debt resolution for 38% of accounts (BM-02), unlocking £3.84M in annual recovery uplift (FA-07).



*Acceptance Criteria:*

*Given* an eligible customer viewing their account summary,

*When* they select "Set Up Payment Plan",

*Then* the portal presents pre-calculated 3, 4, 5, and 6-month monthly installment options.

*Given* a customer selects a plan duration and confirms,

*When* submitted,

*Then* the portal logs the active agreement in the Legacy Database, schedules recurring payment reminders, and generates a downloadable PDF summary.



*Dependencies:* Epic 2, Legacy Collections Database Write API.



*Priority:* High

Creator: Amaal Khandwalla
Description:
*User Story:* As a customer unable to pay today, I want to select a future date when I promise to make a payment, so that I can prevent further escalation without phone friction.



*Business Value:* Eliminates manual promise logging calls and tackles 'awaiting callback' queue stagnation (OPP-03).

*Acceptance Criteria:* 

*Given* an authenticated customer on the payment options screen,

*When* they choose "Promise to Pay Later",

*Then* a calendar picker allows selecting a payment date within a maximum 28-day window.

*Given* a valid promise date selected,

*When* confirmed by the customer,

*Then* the system records the promise record in the Legacy Database and schedules an automated confirmation receipt.



*Dependencies:* Epic 2, Legacy Collections Database Write API.



*Priority:* High

Summary: Story RTE-01: Automated Hardship & Dispute Exit Gateway
Creator: Amaal Khandwalla
Description:
*User Story:* As a customer experiencing financial hardship or disputing a balance, I want the portal to recognize my situation and route me to a specialist, so that I receive human support.



*Business Value:* Mitigates regulatory risk (CR-04) by keeping complex/vulnerable cases strictly representative-led.



*Acceptance Criteria:*

*Given* a customer selects "Experiencing Financial Hardship" or "Dispute Balance",

*When* triggered, 

*Then* self-service option selection is safely halted, and an explanatory transition screen is displayed. 

*Given* the transition screen is acknowledged,

*When* submitted,

*Then* the portal creates an escalated task in the Specialist Representative Queue with a priority flag.



*Dependencies:* Epic 2, Representative Task Queue Interface.



*Priority:* High

Creator: Amaal Khandwalla
Description:
*User Story:* As a Collections Representative, I want escalated or abandoned portal sessions to land in my queue with full interaction history attached, so that I do not make customers repeat information.



*Business Value:* Directly resolves ADKAR Risk CR-02 and eliminates rep rejection of portal-routed cases (SN-108).



*Acceptance Criteria:*

*Given* any portal session routed to a representative (due to failed ID, hardship, dispute, or abandonment),

*When* the task appears in the representative queue,

*Then* it includes a payload containing: Portal Session ID, Authentication Status, Pages Viewed, Selected Options, and Exit Reason Code.



*Dependencies:* RTE-01, VER-01.



*Priority:* High

Summary: Story REP-01: Automated SMS/Email Confirmation Receipts
Creator: Amaal Khandwalla
Description:
*User Story:* As a customer completing a plan or promise, I want to receive an instant SMS and email receipt, so that I have written proof of my agreement.



*Business Value:* Reinforces customer trust and eliminates repeat status check calls.



*Acceptance Criteria:*

*Given* a successfully saved payment plan or promise to pay,

*When* the transaction writes to the database,

*Then* the system triggers an outbound notification containing arrangement details, due dates, and portal reference link.



*Dependencies:* PAY-01, PAY-02, Outbound Messaging Gateway.



*Priority:* High

Summary: Story REP-02: Real-Time Operational Triage & Conversion Dashboard
Creator: Amaal Khandwalla
Description:
*User Story:* As a Collections Team Leader (Gareth Evans), I want a real-time dashboard showing portal conversion rates, routed case volumes, and context hand-off metrics, so that I can verify Phase 1 performance.



*Business Value:* Provides operational observability and satisfies Priya's requirement for concrete management metrics.



*Acceptance Criteria:*

*Given* an Operations Manager viewing the reporting interface,

*When* accessed,

*Then* the dashboard displays: 1. Self-Service Conversion Rate (% eligible accounts resolved digitally), 2. Routed Case Volume by Reason Code (Hardship, Dispute, Failed 2FA), 3. Representative Context Attach Rate (% routed cases with complete logs).



*Dependencies:* VIS-01, PAY-01, RTE-02.

 

*Priority:* Medium
